simple.meaning: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule ; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָעָה (H7462) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 164 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רָעָה (râʻâh) means to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule ; by extension, to associate with (as a friend) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 2.
